name: sorare-football-overlay
description: Production-oriented Sorare football browser overlay monorepo

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@sorare-overlay/shared && npm run build --workspace=@sorare-overlay/api && npm run build --workspace=@sorare-overlay/extension
scripts.analyze:player-prediction: npm run build --workspace=@sorare-overlay/shared && npm run analyze:player-prediction --workspace=@sorare-overlay/api --
scripts.usage:sports-game-odds: npm run build --workspace=@sorare-overlay/shared && npm run usage:sports-game-odds --workspace=@sorare-overlay/api
scripts.test: npm run build --workspace=@sorare-overlay/shared && npm run test --workspace=@sorare-overlay/shared && npm run test --workspace=@sorare-overlay/api && npm run test --workspace=@sorare-overlay/extension
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace=@sorare-overlay/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace=@sorare-overlay/api && npm run typecheck --workspace=@sorare-overlay/extension
scripts.verify: npm run codegen && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
